paragraphs.text: The Mississippi Department of Transportation’s bid tabulation for the Oct. 27 letting lists a $335,270 bid from Riverside Traffic Systems, Inc. for safety improvements on MS 336 in Pontotoc County.

The project covers MS 336 from US 278 to Apostolic Circle. MDOT describes the work as audible stripe, raised pavement markers and sign improvements; it is identified as Call 14, Federal Aid Project HRRR-1336-58(003), project number 110210301.

The document reports bids rather than a contract-award decision. It does not establish when construction will begin. The full tabulation and Pontotoc News’ earlier coverage of the solicitation are linked below.
